packed_format.code: existing signed int8 two's-complement code, reinterpreted as uint8
packed_format.plane_order: least-significant code bit through sign bit
packed_format.within_byte_order: flattened code i occupies bit i modulo 8; little bit order
packed_format.projection_padding: zero-pad each projection plane to a whole byte
packed_format.reconstruction: unpack selected high planes, clear omitted low bits, sign-extend, then call unchanged qaq.quantization.reconstruct and cast FP16

storage_modes.resident: all eight packed planes and every scale stay on GPU; no execution H2D loads
storage_modes.ondemand_sync: all source planes/scales stay on ordinary unpinned CPU memory; one reusable maximum-block GPU slot receives selected planes and all current-block scales synchronously; ownership is released after the block

evaluation.sample_order: unchanged frozen examples order filtered to wikitext2
evaluation.profiles: unchanged saved adaptive task/index profiles; no router execution

accounting.request: one selected current attention or FFN block payload
accounting.requested_bytes: ceil(total selected logical plane bits in the block / 8) plus scale tensor bytes
accounting.copied_bytes: actual selected packed projection-plane tensor bytes including per-projection tail padding plus scale tensor bytes
accounting.load: one synchronous current-block CPU-to-GPU payload operation, independent of its row-wise copies
accounting.release: one clearing of on-demand slot ownership after current-block execution
accounting.transfer_time: perf_counter interval around blocking copies, with CUDA synchronized immediately before the interval and after all copies
accounting.startup: runner main entry through integrity checks, CPU checkpoint load, packing, dense remainder GPU move, storage placement/slot creation, and final synchronization
accounting.measurement: after gc, empty_cache, synchronization, peak reset, and counter reset; includes route lookup, scorer/model computation, transfers, CPU loss copy, and raw sample writes; ends after CUDA synchronization

gates.cpu: all signed codes plus padded lengths reconstruct torch.equal to qaq.quantization.reconstruct at 4,6,8; invalid inputs fail
gates.tiny_qwen: resident and ondemand_sync logits torch.equal existing NestedLinear logits for fixed4/fixed6/fixed8 and a mixed attention/FFN profile; byte/load/release/one-slot and exception release checks pass
gates.full_smoke: fresh one-example resident and ondemand_sync raw sample files are exactly equal; ondemand_sync peak allocated bytes is strictly lower; sources/profile/sample/model hashes match
gates.repeat_authorization: full smoke passes and projected wall time for each full job is at most 30 minutes
gates.full_repeats: three fresh paired 64-window runs preserve exact within-pair raw samples and profiles; all measurements reported without target percentages
gates.output_mismatch: stop full repeats and revise loader
gates.memory_nonreduction: after confirming no on-demand source plane/scale is GPU resident outside the one slot, stop with evidence
